description: India Meteorological Department Data Supply Portal is a data portal run by India Meteorological Department. The portal supplies gridded and station rainfall, temperature and other climate data sets of the national weather service to researchers on request, with catalogue pages for each data set. Coverage: India. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as netcdf, grd; access varies, with some data sets free for research on request and others charged. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("IMD-DSP") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support weather and climate inputs for Indian infrastructure studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
